_comment: Pinned LPSim provenance — one source of truth for the GPU 3rd engine.
Mirrors the role osm_data/manifest.json plays for state PBFs.
When the upstream repo or Docker image is updated and SimForge wants to
track that change, bump the values below and re-run:
The sbatch reads LPSIM_GIT_SHA / LPSIM_DOCKER_REF from this file via the
`jq` helper — see the sbatch header for the exact lookup.

lpsim.cuda_runtime_note: The image is named `cuda12.4` and ships CUDA 12.4 dev tools, but the bundled LivingCity binary was compiled against libcudart.so.11.0 — confirmed via `ldd /LivingCity/LivingCity` on Pitzer 2026-04-26. The adapter therefore bind-mounts the host's CUDA 11.x lib dir (set by `module load cuda/11.8.0` on Pitzer) into the container and points LD_LIBRARY_PATH at it. Bumping this manifest to a future LPSim image with a correctly-built binary may let us drop the cuda/11.8.0 host requirement.
lpsim.verified_by: Singularity pull succeeded on Pitzer p0230 (Tesla V100, Apptainer 1.3.6); ldd of /LivingCity/LivingCity inside the SIF shows libcudart.so.11.0 as the only unresolved dependency.

build_dependencies._comment: C++ system dependencies LPSim's Dockerfile + LivingCity Makefile need. On Pitzer these are loaded via lmod modules (see build_lpsim.sbatch); on a custom build the operator must provide them.
build_dependencies.pandana: git@HEAD (built from UDST/pandana, no version pin upstream)
